title: gh-aw / SLO Overview
description: Glance: is the agentic-workflow fleet meeting expectations right now, and which happiness factor is not? Five boxes, one per happiness factor: green (every SLO met), yellow (at risk) or red (breached). Click a box to scan which workflows violate it.

panels.title: Telemetry health (A4): data may be understated when red
panels.description:

SLI: A4.

panels.title: Availability
panels.description:
Question: Are users happy with Availability: workflows run when triggered and are not stuck or dead? Worst SLI state across the factor: green 100% = every SLO met, yellow 50% = at least one at risk, red 0% = at least one breached. Click to scan which workflows violate it.
Metrics: Tier A: emitted by gh-aw.
SLI: A1, A2, A3, A4.
Ignores variables: workflow, job, model (fleet level).
